name: application-toasts
title: Toasts
description: Temporary notification banners that appear to confirm actions, report errors, or surface warnings without blocking the user's workflow, with success, error, warning, info, action, and standout variants.
useWhen: Confirming that a user action succeeded, such as 'Changes saved' or 'Item deleted'.
Surfacing non-blocking error or warning messages that do not require immediate user intervention.
Providing brief contextual feedback that should dismiss itself automatically after a few seconds.
avoidWhen: The message requires the user to make a decision — use a modal or inline alert instead.
The error is critical and must not be missed — a toast that auto-dismisses is too ephemeral for critical errors.
Multiple simultaneous toasts are needed — stacked toasts overwhelm users; queue them or use a notification center.
responsiveBehavior: Toasts are typically positioned fixed at the bottom-right or top-right of the viewport. On mobile they span the full width at the bottom of the screen. Z-index must be high enough to appear above modals and overlays.
accessibility: Use role='status' and aria-live='polite' for informational toasts so screen readers announce them without interrupting.
Use role='alert' and aria-live='assertive' for error toasts that require immediate attention.
Include a close button in toasts so keyboard users can dismiss them without waiting for auto-dismiss.

variants.title: Success
variants.description: Green-themed toast confirming that a user action completed successfully, such as saving, submitting, or deleting.
accessibility: Uses role='status' and aria-live='polite'; success icon is aria-hidden with the message text carrying the meaning.

variants.title: Success (Dark)
variants.description: Success toast adapted for dark application surfaces with dark background and light success-colored icon and text.
accessibility: Success icon and message text must meet WCAG AA contrast on the dark toast background.

variants.title: Error
variants.description: Red-themed toast reporting that an action failed, such as a network error, validation failure, or server rejection.
accessibility: Error toasts use role='alert' and aria-live='assertive' to interrupt the screen reader immediately.

variants.title: Error (Dark)
variants.description: Error toast adapted for dark surfaces, keeping the red error icon and message legible against dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Error text and icon must meet contrast requirements; do not rely on red color alone to communicate failure.

variants.title: Warning
variants.description: Amber-themed toast surfacing a caution condition that the user should be aware of but that doesn't block their current task.
accessibility: Warning toasts use role='status'; the warning icon is aria-hidden and text carries the full message.

variants.title: Warning (Dark)
variants.description: Warning toast adapted for dark surfaces with amber warning icon and message text visible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Amber warning colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark toast backgrounds.

variants.title: Info
variants.description: Blue-themed toast for informational messages that provide context or updates without indicating success or failure.
accessibility: Informational toasts use role='status' and aria-live='polite'; icon is aria-hidden with text carrying the meaning.

variants.title: Info (Dark)
variants.description: Informational toast adapted for dark surfaces with blue info icon and message text legible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Blue info icon and message text must meet contrast requirements on dark toast backgrounds.

variants.title: With action button
variants.description: Toast with an embedded action button allowing users to undo the last action, view details, or navigate directly from the notification.
accessibility: Action button inside the toast must be keyboard focusable; if the toast auto-dismisses, pause the timer on focus.

variants.title: With action button (Dark)
variants.description: Action-button toast adapted for dark surfaces, keeping the embedded action clearly distinguishable on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Action button text and border must meet contrast requirements against the dark toast background.

variants.title: Standout
variants.description: High-contrast solid-background toast with strong visual weight — use for critical status messages that must not be missed in a busy UI.
accessibility: High-contrast backgrounds increase visual urgency; ensure icon and text still meet WCAG AA on the standout background color.

variants.title: Standout (Dark)
variants.description: High-contrast standout toast adapted for dark surfaces, retaining its visual prominence against dark application backgrounds.
accessibility: Standout background must remain distinct from the dark page background; text must meet contrast on the standout color.
